subject: Recreational event - Pumpkin Bowl Regatta - Howe Sound, Strait of Georgia, Vancouver Harbour
text:
Recreational event - Pumpkin Bowl Regatta - Howe Sound, Strait of Georgia, Vancouver Harbour
The Pumpkin Bowl Regatta will take place at the East Entrance of Howe Sound inside a boundary from Whytecliff Park, Dorman Bay, Passage Island and Point Atkinson. 
The regatta will run from 1500 UTC to 0100 UTC October 17 and 18. 
The regatta will have up to 150 vessels on the water.
Support vessels will be standing by on VHF channels 12, 16, 69 and 72.
Caution.
